agent.twoPaths: Two paths — pick one. Both authenticate with a scoped API key ({{apiKey}}) — the only auth path.
agent.firstKeyBody: sign in here with the ZKProofport mobile app (scan the QR — the proof is generated on your phone), then open {{myLink}} → Settings → AI agents and create a key. It is shown once. After that an authenticated agent can mint more with {{apikeyCreate}}.
agent.deviceFlowWarning: Interactive {{loginCmd}} (Google device flow) is temporarily unavailable — the ZKProofport prover service is offline. Use an API key.

pathA.label: A. MCP · recommended for LLM agents
pathA.desc: Add the local {{mcpPkg}} stdio server to your MCP client (Claude, Cursor, …). It runs in your own environment and calls the {{tools}} tools. No hosted {{mcpEndpoint}} endpoint.

pathB.label: B. CLI · humans & scripts
pathB.desc: Install the {{cli}} CLI and set {{env}} — there is no login step. (You can also pass {{flag}} or save {{creds}}.)

advanced.label: Advanced · No-MCP / raw REST (CI, bash)
advanced.desc: For clients that cannot run MCP and prefer raw HTTP. The API key is a plain Bearer credential, so there is nothing to install.

aiAgentSettings.signInRequired: Please sign in to manage AI agents.
aiAgentSettings.intro: An AI agent logged in as you acts on your account. Each API key you mint carries its OWN scope — exactly what that key's sessions may do across OpenStoa. There is no account-wide AI permission any more: create a key with the scope you want, then edit or revoke it any time. Your own actions are never restricted.
